items.title: The Power of Antigravity (AGY)
items.summary: Deep research and document synthesis with 1M context windows.
items.content_html:
The Power of Antigravity (AGY)

When it comes to processing massive amounts of information, Antigravity (AGY) is our go-to agent.

With a 1M-token context window, AGY can ingest entire codebases, 500-page PDFs, or complex research corpora in a single session.

Use Cases

  • Competitive Research: Analyzing dozens of competitor sites and strategy papers.
  • Visual QA: Comparing screenshots and design mockups with pixel precision.
  • Knowledge Synthesis: Creating summary reports from years of archived logs.

AGY transforms "Too Long; Didn't Read" into actionable intelligence.

items.title: Scaling with Jules
items.summary: How we use async remote VMs to handle hundreds of PRs daily.
items.content_html:
Scaling with Jules

In this post, we'll dive into the architecture that allows Jules to handle massive throughput for GitHub PRs.

The secret lies in our use of asynchronous remote VMs. Every task spawns a temporary, isolated environment where the code is cloned, modified, and verified.

"Goal delegation, not task delegation."

By providing Jules with a clear goal and the necessary context, it can work independently of the main orchestrator, freeing up resources for other tasks.

Benefits

  1. Isolation: No local environment pollution.
  2. Parallelism: Run up to 300 sessions per day.
  3. Safety: Changes are proposed via PRs, requiring human or second-agent approval.

items.title: Welcome to the Prismatic Swarm
items.summary: Introducing the new Prismatic Agent Hub for multi-agent coordination.
items.content_html:
Welcome to the Prismatic Swarm

We are excited to announce the launch of the Prismatic Agent Hub (codenamed Prism).

This hub acts as a central coordinator for our heterogeneous fleet of AI workers. By splitting incoming tasks into specialized wavelengths, we achieve full-spectrum autonomy.

Key Features

  • Hub-and-Spoke Design: Central coordinator + specialized agents.
  • Bolt-on Skills: Easily extendable capabilities.
  • Platform Agnostic: Works with Hermes, Open Claw, and more.

Stay tuned for more updates!
